_comment: Changes that the pipeline adds to the GarageBand patch of a speaker. Key = the name of the track file (Ran#01.wav = Ran). highpass = new low-cut frequency in Hz, in place of the one in the patch. post = ffmpeg filters after the patch. Selected by Ran on 2026-11-24 from six samples (option E, 'Radio, vivid'). Ori keeps the patch with no change.
